limitations: 336 independent maps, one root each; repeats and candidates are clustered within maps, not additional independent maps.

Every fork initializes the same original map_seed and flag_seed and replays the common prefix. Future flag placements/RNG consumption can differ with state; wall-clock search and bot RNG are not controlled by an explicit repeat seed.

Original engine prefix orders are forced after fresh bots compute replies; forced candidate does not rewrite bot memory. Full computed/played replies and prefix mismatch/fault receipts permit an independent audit.
Root opportunities and fallback shortages remain; no root selected from final utility or future replies.
Shortlist is a bounded set of logged complete requested orders, not exhaustive legal-action enumeration. Target/canonical aliases and learnability remain unaudited until T0038.
Preflight recorded probes do not guarantee fault-free long matches. All collection faults and partials are reported, not quarantined retroactively.

category_definitions.contact: living enemy within Manhattan4 of a living own unit

plan.continuation_policy: common recorded opponent root actions, live/reactive after root; fresh process full-prefix replay; forced action does not rewrite carrier memory; repeats retain original flag stream and are not IID new maps
plan.expansion_and_stop_rule: run every declared map and selected candidate four times; no expansion or early favorable stop. Preserve faults/errors/partial rows. A stopped job is not restarted automatically. Resume verifies existing byte hashes and only attempts missing stages.
plan.policy: admitted P2 XXL / V off / v12_ponly_xxl_dlog log-only, its distinct host binary identity
plan.root_selection: each count has four requested maps per category (carrier, flag, contact, interception, defense, quiet); among observable TURNs t>=6 with a valid scored logged incumbent (K1 allowed), pick minimum SHA hash in the requested category; otherwise deterministic category rotation fallback. No final score, future reply or realized successor selects a root. Retain all stratum opportunities, rejected log reasons, actual logged K and collected K, shortages and fallback.
plan.split_rule: training.decision_dataset.split_of_map; all candidates and repeats of one map remain in its split
